install: set -euo pipefail; OTP_VERSION=OTP-28.3.1; ELIXIR_VERSION=v1.19.5-otp-28; FOUNDRY_VERSION=v1.7.1; ARCH=$(uname -m); case "$ARCH" in x86_64) ARCH=amd64;; aarch64|arm64) ARCH=arm64;; esac; OTP_DIR="$HOME/.local/erlang/$OTP_VERSION"; ELIXIR_DIR="$HOME/.local/elixir/$ELIXIR_VERSION"; FOUNDRY_DIR="$HOME/.foundry/bin"; if [ ! -x "$OTP_DIR/bin/erl" ]; then mkdir -p "$OTP_DIR"; curl -fsSL "https://builds.hex.pm/builds/otp/${ARCH}/ubuntu-22.04/${OTP_VERSION}.tar.gz" | tar -xz --strip-components=1 -C "$OTP_DIR"; (cd "$OTP_DIR" && ./Install -minimal "$OTP_DIR"); fi; if [ ! -x "$ELIXIR_DIR/bin/elixir" ]; then mkdir -p "$ELIXIR_DIR"; tmp_zip=$(mktemp); curl -fsSL "https://builds.hex.pm/builds/elixir/${ELIXIR_VERSION}.zip" -o "$tmp_zip"; unzip -q -o "$tmp_zip" -d "$ELIXIR_DIR"; rm -f "$tmp_zip"; fi; if [ ! -x "$FOUNDRY_DIR/anvil" ]; then mkdir -p "$FOUNDRY_DIR"; curl -fsSL "https://github.com/foundry-rs/foundry/releases/download/${FOUNDRY_VERSION}/foundry_${FOUNDRY_VERSION}_linux_${ARCH}.tar.gz" | tar -xz -C "$FOUNDRY_DIR"; fi; touch "$HOME/.bashrc"; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; PATH_LINE="export PATH=\"$ELIXIR_DIR/bin:$OTP_DIR/bin:$FOUNDRY_DIR:\$PATH\""; grep -qxF "$PATH_LINE" "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo "$PATH_LINE" >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; export PATH="$ELIXIR_DIR/bin:$OTP_DIR/bin:$FOUNDRY_DIR:$PATH"; if [ -f /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt ]; then CA_LINE='export HEX_CACERTS_PATH=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt'; grep -qxF "$CA_LINE" "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo "$CA_LINE" >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; export HEX_CACERTS_PATH=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt; fi; mix local.hex --force --if-missing; mix local.rebar --force --if-missing; mix deps.get
